metadata.name: The Machine that conquered the Aether
metadata.author: Stahlregen & fishbrain + flexi + geiss
metadata.source: Stahlregen & fishbrain + flexi + geiss - The Machine that conquered the Aether.milk

reasons.message: Requires custom texture-slot sampler binding and texture-manager evaluation.
Uses HLSL scalar aliases that must be normalized before GLSL generation.
Uses textured custom shapes; texture sampling on shapes is not yet supported — shapes render as flat-color geometry.

issues.message: References custom sampler names; imported texture-slot assets are not currently provisioned in the runtime.
